summary: Executed backend API regression (9 pytest cases) and frontend E2E checks for homepage, Fan Wall, modal, like/share, submit, moderation visibility, and mobile behavior using public URL.
action_items: Consider server-side anti-abuse/idempotency for POST /api/fan-wall/{id}/like; currently repeated direct API calls can continue increasing likes.
Populate /app/memory/test_credentials.md if future auth flows are introduced (currently empty).
critical_code_review_comments: Like endpoint has no server-side uniqueness guard (no token/session/IP throttling or user-level dedupe), so counters are vulnerable to scripted inflation.
Frontend one-time-like is enforced only in component state and resets after reload/new session.
seed_data_creation: Created automated test submissions via POST /api/fan-wall; records are unapproved by design and remain hidden from public list.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop and mobile portal flows validated on https://fan-wall-cards.preview.emergentagent.com. First mobile-menu check timed out once in long script but passed immediately on isolated retest (likely timing/flaky automation, not reproducible product bug).
rca of the issue: Potential integrity gap: likes are mutable through repeated direct API calls because backend does not track voter identity or rate-limit like events; UI-only guard is bypassable.
